title: docs: content/docs/ui/apps.mdx should say that a runtime-created package refuses navigationContributions (PR #30707)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: a `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line from PR #30707 (#30072, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** PR #30707 makes the runtime package door refuse `navigationContributions` and name the routes that work instead: an app override for a customer's own menu (#30059), and a code package for a contribution. `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` describes navigation contributions but does not say that a package created at runtime cannot carry them. An author who reads only the docs will try the key and hit the refusal.

**Wanted.** Add one sentence to `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`, beside the existing description of `navigationContributions`. It should say that the key is honoured only from a code package loaded at boot, that the runtime door refuses it, and which two routes to use instead. Land it after PR #30707 merges, so the docs match `main`.

Reader: `domain:devx` (`content/docs/**`). Suggested-grade: p3 · a one-sentence doc gap that follows a narrowing.
